_comment: Copy to .claude/gates.json and replace with commands that actually pass today. fast = every edit; full = before any 'done' claim; deferred = CI only.

fast.name: unit
fast.cmd: echo 'TODO: your fast unit test command'

deferred: _comment_holdout: needs HOLDOUT_DIR pointing OUTSIDE the repo. Isolation, not secrecy, is the property that matters — a red team scored 100% on SWE-bench Verified and Pro via a conftest.py hook without solving anything. Reports the visible-vs-held-out gap; no threshold.

_comment_mutate: diff-scoped, <=1 mutant per line, dismissible via a Mutation-Dismissed commit trailer. No score threshold on purpose — Google runs this across >24,000 developers without one, and unfiltered mutants were rated 85% unproductive.

_comment_ambiguity: surfaces decisions the code makes that the spec never mentions — magic thresholds, fixture-id special cases, unstated return values. Ambiguity is the largest measured lever on agent misbehaviour (hardcoding 0-2.1% on specified tasks vs 22-44% on ambiguous ones). It is also the LEAST-evidenced gate here: the decision-point patterns are a judgment call, not a finding. Measured 0 false positives in benchmark/gates. Set AG_STRICT=1 to block.
